propositions: Ticking an Acceptance Criteria checkbox does not invalidate plan-review attestations because checkbox state is normalized before hashing into the material fingerprint.
Stale-material attestation error messages must name the specific changed component(s) rather than reporting a fixed enumeration of all possible basis keys.
The misleading fixed-list literal `description/AC/file_impact/children` survives in runtime source prose and must be removed while preserving per-component diagnostic reasons.
Legacy attestation manifests without per-component fingerprints must degrade honestly by naming the differing component category rather than inventing diagnostics.
Unsigned claim-gate advice must offer both remedies: `review-plan` when no review exists and `sign-review` when a passed review signature failed to persist.

Dependency-material and reopened-state staleness messages must be named consistently across generation, resignation, and completion-closure paths with deterministic additive `material-part` records for manifest round-tripping.
